# Pinned upstream RULER scoring fixtures

Unmodified files from NVIDIA/RULER revision
`c3f5e3b4f87f97e048793bb510a3a6b19a46bf3a`, licensed under Apache 2.0
(see LICENSE). `constants.py.txt` is the original
`scripts/eval/synthetic/constants.py`; the text suffix prevents project formatters
from modifying upstream code. `synthetic.yaml` is `scripts/synthetic.yaml`.

Used to exercise native task-to-metric mappings through public run tests.
They are scoring fixtures, not generated model outcomes.
